    How many episodes are there of The Pitt?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    The Pitt has two seasons, with each season consisting of 15 episodes, for a total of 30 episodes released or airing on Max as of March 2026, following a unique format where each episode covers one hour of a 15-hour shift in a Pittsburgh hospital's emergency room. Season 1 concluded, and Season 2 is currently airing weekly, set to finish in April 2026. 
    Key Details: 
    • Total Episodes: 30 (15 per season).
    • Seasons: 2.
    • Platform: Max (formerly HBO Max).
    • Format: Each episode is one hour, representing one hour of a single 15-hour shift.
    • Status: Season 2 is airing new episodes weekly as of March 2026.

      Is there going to be any more episodes of The Pitt?
      An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
      AI Overview
      Yes, The Pitt has already returned for Season 2, which premiered on HBO Max in January 2026, and was even renewed for a Season 3 before Season 2 began, confirming its continuation for fans. Season 2 picks up with the ER staff during a chaotic Fourth of July weekend, following a time jump for Dr. Robby's recovery, and adds new challenges and characters while continuing its real-time, 15-hour shift format.
       
      Key Details about Season 2:
      • Release: Premiered January 8, 2026, with weekly episodes on HBO Max. 
      • Format: Continues with 15 episodes, each covering one hour of a 15-hour shift. 
      • Plot: Focuses on the aftermath of Season 1, with Dr. Robby (Noah Wyle) returning from rehab and new medical and personal conflicts arising, including a clash with new doctor Al-Hashimi (Sepideh Moafi). 
      • Renewal: Already renewed for a third season, announced before Season 2's debut.

        No, there won't be a Season 1 Episode 16 of The Pitt because Season 1 had only 15 episodes, but Season 2 is currently airing on Max (formerly HBO Max), with episodes continuing through April 2026, so you're likely looking for an episode from the current Season 2. As of March 12, 2026, Season 2 is up to Episode 10, with Episode 15 scheduled for April 16, 2026, meaning the show has plenty more episodes airing. 
        Key Details:
        • Season 1: Concluded with 15 episodes. 
        • Season 2: Also has 15 episodes, mirroring a 15-hour workday for the characters. 
        • Current Status: As of March 12, 2026, Season 2 is airing, and new episodes (like the upcoming Episode 11 on March 19) are released weekly. 
        • Where to Watch: Stream new episodes on Max (HBO Max).

          Spoiler warning 🚨 In season two of 'The Pitt', a new attending physician is determined to improve efficiencies at the hospital. She tells her skeptical staff that new AI systems can cut down their time spent on charting by 80%, allowing them to spend more time both at the bedside and at home. But in episode six, doctors discover that the AI tool has made up false details about a patient and confused “urology” for “neurology.” Like many of the show’s themes, this storyline mirrors real-life debates happening in hospitals across the country. Tech correspondent Andrew Chow explains how AI is already being used by medical professionals, how they feel about it. Read more at the link in bio.
